title: Microsoft Purview: sensitivity label groups replace parent labels (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: Hold: the migration and label-group creation PowerShell calls have documented parameter names, but Microsoft does not describe what those switches do. They should not be presented as verified automation for an irreversible migration or for creating label groups. The roadmap facts and the main migration guidance are supported.

claims.claim: The groupings let administrators organise and categorise labels, previously done with parent labels.
claims.quote: These new label groupings allow admins to better organize and categorize their labels (previously done via parent labels).

claims.claim: The policy-publishing control is reached through Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies > policy > Edit Policy.

To edit an existing label policy, select it, and then select the Edit Policy button from the flyout pane:

claims.fix: Extend controls[2].ui and its rendered row to "Solutions > Information Protection > Publishing policies > policy > Edit Policy > Choose sensitivity labels to publish > Choose sensitivity labels to publish". claims.claim: Set-LabelPolicy -Identity <policy> -RemoveLabels <label> unpublishes the newly created same-name sublabel using Security & Compliance PowerShell.

Set-LabelPolicy -Identity $policyToRemove -RemoveLabels $_

claims.fix: Remove "Edit any same-name sublabel you left published before users rely on it" from the After rollout checklist. Keep the existing policy-publishing control; do not add an unverified control row.
